documents.title: Access control
documents.summary: Access to information and related assets should be governed by rules based on business and information-security requirements.
documents.source_note: Project-authored summary; verify against an authorized copy of ISO/IEC 27001:2022 before audit use.

documents.title: Identity management
documents.summary: Identity lifecycles should be managed from registration through change and removal so that identities remain controlled and traceable.
documents.source_note: Project-authored summary; verify against an authorized copy of ISO/IEC 27001:2022 before audit use.

documents.title: Authentication information
documents.summary: Authentication information should be assigned and managed through controlled processes, with users advised how to handle it securely.
documents.source_note: Project-authored summary; verify against an authorized copy of ISO/IEC 27001:2022 before audit use.

documents.title: Access rights
documents.summary: Access rights should be provisioned, reviewed, changed, and removed according to access-control rules and business needs.
documents.source_note: Project-authored summary; verify against an authorized copy of ISO/IEC 27001:2022 before audit use.

documents.title: ISMS scope
documents.summary: Define and document the ISMS boundaries and applicability, considering organizational context, interested-party requirements, and interfaces or dependencies with other organizations.
documents.source_note: Project-authored summary; checked against the supplied ISO/IEC 27001:2022 PDF, PDF pages 8, clause 4.3. Not verbatim ISO text. The approved 2013 gap-analysis report provides case context, not the authority for this 2022 requirement.

documents.title: Information security policy
documents.summary: Management establishes an appropriate information security policy covering objectives or their framework, applicable requirements, and continual improvement. Document and communicate the policy and make it available to relevant interested parties as appropriate.
documents.source_note: Project-authored summary; checked against the supplied ISO/IEC 27001:2022 PDF, PDF pages 9, clause 5.2. Not verbatim ISO text. The approved 2013 gap-analysis report provides case context, not the authority for this 2022 requirement.

documents.title: Information security roles and responsibilities
documents.summary: Assign and communicate responsibilities and authorities for information security roles, including ISMS conformity and reporting ISMS performance to management.
documents.source_note: Project-authored summary; checked against the supplied ISO/IEC 27001:2022 PDF, PDF pages 9, clause 5.3. Not verbatim ISO text. The approved 2013 gap-analysis report provides case context, not the authority for this 2022 requirement.

documents.title: Information security risk assessment process
documents.summary: Define, document and apply a repeatable risk assessment process. Set assessment and acceptance criteria, identify risks and owners, analyse likelihood and consequences, and evaluate priorities.
documents.source_note: Project-authored summary; checked against the supplied ISO/IEC 27001:2022 PDF, PDF pages 10, clause 6.1.2. Not verbatim ISO text. The approved 2013 gap-analysis report provides case context, not the authority for this 2022 requirement.

documents.title: Information security risk treatment process
documents.summary: Select risk treatment options and necessary controls using assessment results. Check coverage against Annex A, prepare a Statement of Applicability and treatment plan, and obtain risk owner approval of the plan and acceptance of residual risks. Retain documentation of the process.
documents.source_note: Project-authored summary; checked against the supplied ISO/IEC 27001:2022 PDF, PDF pages 10-11, clause 6.1.3. Not verbatim ISO text. The approved 2013 gap-analysis report provides case context, not the authority for this 2022 requirement.

documents.title: Information security objectives
documents.summary: Set documented information security objectives at relevant functions and levels. Monitor and communicate them, measure them where practicable, and plan actions, resources, responsibilities, completion dates and evaluation of results.
documents.source_note: Project-authored summary; checked against the supplied ISO/IEC 27001:2022 PDF, PDF pages 11, clause 6.2. Not verbatim ISO text. The approved 2013 gap-analysis report provides case context, not the authority for this 2022 requirement.

documents.title: Competence
documents.summary: Determine the competence needed for work affecting information security performance. Ensure suitable education, training or experience, evaluate competence-building actions where applicable, and retain appropriate evidence of competence.
documents.source_note: Project-authored summary; checked against the supplied ISO/IEC 27001:2022 PDF, PDF pages 12, clause 7.2. Not verbatim ISO text. The approved 2013 gap-analysis report provides case context, not the authority for this 2022 requirement.

documents.title: Awareness
documents.summary: People working under organizational control need awareness of the information security policy, their contribution to ISMS effectiveness, and the implications of failing to meet ISMS requirements. A missing formal course alone does not prove that people lack awareness.
documents.source_note: Project-authored summary; checked against the supplied ISO/IEC 27001:2022 PDF, PDF pages 12, clause 7.3. Not verbatim ISO text. The approved 2013 gap-analysis report provides case context, not the authority for this 2022 requirement.

documents.title: Control of documented information
documents.summary: Keep required ISMS documentation available and suitable when needed, and protect it appropriately. Address access, retrieval, distribution, storage, preservation, change control, retention and disposal as applicable.
documents.source_note: Project-authored summary; checked against the supplied ISO/IEC 27001:2022 PDF, PDF pages 13, clause 7.5.3. Not verbatim ISO text. The approved 2013 gap-analysis report provides case context, not the authority for this 2022 requirement.

documents.title: Internal audit programme
documents.summary: Maintain an internal audit programme covering frequency, methods, responsibilities, planning and reporting. Define audit scope and criteria, ensure auditor objectivity, report results to relevant management, and retain evidence of programme execution and results.
documents.source_note: Project-authored summary; checked against the supplied ISO/IEC 27001:2022 PDF, PDF pages 15, clause 9.2.2. Not verbatim ISO text. The approved 2013 gap-analysis report provides case context, not the authority for this 2022 requirement.
